Name: Processing Station - Farm Building (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=5]General[/size][/b]
The Processing Station is farm building that processes your crops, forage and animal products in bulk. Simply load all of your items into the input box and collect your finished artisan goods the next day, similar to the mill.

The machine has 36 slots, allowing you to input up to 36 different stacks of items per day for each machine you have built on your farm. Once the machine is full, it will no longer accept items until the current batch is ready the next day.
You can input all different types of accepted items at the same time, so for example, you don't have to wait for your wine to finish processing in order to put in your wool to make cloth. They will both be ready for pickup the next day, along with any other items you put in. I've uploaded a demonstration to the videos section of this mod page. 

To load an item or a stack of items into the machine, just hold it and click on the input box while standing next to it. 

[b][size=5]Compatibility [/size][/b]
This mod works with all vanilla artisan goods, as well as items from Stardew Valley Expanded. Other expansions may be added on request, but are not currently supported. 

[size=5][b]Item Conversion[/b][/size]
[b]These items are accepted by the machine and turned into their correlating artisan goods:[/b]
Eggs (all) 
Wool
Milk (all) 
Truffles 

Vegetables are converted to their pickle version, while fruits are turned into their flavored wine, with the following exceptions:
Wheat -> Beer
Hops -> Pale Ale
Unmilled rice -> Rice 
Sunflower -> Oil
Coffee Beans -> Coffee

You can also produce:
Mead (honey) 
Green Tea (tea leaves) 
Vinegar (rice) 

Processable SVE items 
Fruits, veggies, forage
Camel Wool 
Goose Egg 

For a better visual overview, see the images tab of this mod page. 

[b][size=5]Configurations with Generic Mod Config Menu [/size][/b]
[b]WinterTexture[/b]
Enables/disables snow on the building during winter. Default false. 
[b]
EarthyTexture[/b]
Changes the colors of the building to a more desaturated/earthy version in line with DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour. Default false. 

[b]BuildingCost [/b]
Changes the price of the building. Options:
Cheap: 50,000g
Default: 100,000g
Expensive: 500,000g
Capitalist: 1,000,000g

[b]BuildingMaterials[/b]
Changes the materials required for  construction. Options:
Cheap: 500 wood, 10 iron bars, 5 battery packs 
Default: 500 wood, 10 iron bars, 1 keg, 1 preserves jar, 1 loom, 1 oil maker, 1 cheese press, 1 mayonnaise machine 
Expensive: 999 wood, 100 iron bars, 5 kegs, 5 preserves jars, 5 looms, 5 oil makers, 5 cheese presses, 5 mayonnaise machines 

Please let me know if you have any questions or issues with the mod. 
Enjoy!
